# `apply_patch`

> Profile: deferred · Permission key: `[permission] apply_patch`

Apply a unified diff. Prefer `edit` for exact string replacements. `path` is required for a single-file patch without `+++` headers; omit it (or pass `.`) for a multi-file `diff --git` / `+++ b/…` patch. Native — no `patch(1)`.

Deferred tools are not advertised on every request. Activate one with `tool_search` or set `session.tool_profile = "full"`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `patch_content` | string | yes | Unified diff (---/+++ headers optional for a single file; @@ hunks required) |
| `path` | string | no | File to patch when the diff has no +++ headers. Optional for multi-file diffs (use `.` or omit). |
